subject: Technical evaluation blueprint + MAP milestones (draft)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthgrid.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical evaluation blueprint + MAP milestones (draft)

Hi Elena / Sam —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Attached is a first-pass technical evaluation blueprint mapped to the Mutual Action Plan milestones we discussed. High-level summary below so the team can review quickly: 

Scope
- Goal: validate latency, unit cost, and functional quality for HealthGrid’s patient-summary use case (2k token inputs; structured output with JSON schema).
- Test types: functional acceptance (BLEU/EM/slot accuracy), performance (p95 latency), and cost-per-1k-tokens.

Acceptance criteria (proposed)
- Functional: 95% pass rate on the 200-sample acceptance set (weighted by slot importance).
- Latency: p95 < 150 ms for 512-token outputs on our Dedicated config (GPU T4-equivalent).
- Cost: inference cost <= $0.20 / 1k output tokens (including batching/caching assumptions).

Model shortlist (initial)
- Mistral-7B (quantized)
- Llama-2-13B-quant
- Redwood-optimized v0.9 (medium latency profile)

Milestones & owners (MAP draft)
- Week 1 (Aug 24–28): environment provisioning & sample dataset handoff — Owner: HealthGrid (Elena) / Redwood infra prep — Owner: Diego
- Week 2 (Aug 31–Sep 4): run latency & functional bench — Owner: Rishi (Redwood) / HealthGrid support for integration
- Week 3 (Sep 7–11): quality review and tuning; compare model tradeoffs — Owner: Marissa (Redwood)
- Target close: 2026-09-30 (mutual sign-off on performance/cost)

Dependencies: keys/SSO for test account, access to a sanitized sample dataset, procurement sign-off for dedicated test capacity.

Attachments: redwood-map-draft.xlsx (MAP with milestone dates), hw-benchmark-specs.pdf (expected infra profile), eval-dataset-sample.jsonl (50 examples), latency-bench-script.sh (bench harness).

Please flag anything that looks off and we’ll update the draft. If you prefer, we can run a 90-minute technical workshop next week to walk through the benchmark harness and expected outputs.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthgrid.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@healthgrid.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, procure@healthgrid.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical evaluation blueprint + MAP milestones (draft)

Diego —

Thanks for the thorough draft, this helps a lot. Quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) Latency target: the product team prefers tighter SLOs for interactive features — can you provide a runbook for the p95 measurement (are we measuring from request arrival to final token or end-to-end including network?)
2) Cost calc: show the assumptions (batch size, average seq length) used to estimate $0.20 / 1k. We need this for procurement to budget the test credits.
3) Data residency / SOC2: procurement looped me in; we’ll need a short note on data flow for the test run (which systems store logs) — can you attach SOC2/DR notes?

We can do the technical workshop on Wed Aug 26 10:00–11:30 PT — Sam and I are available.

Elena
Head of Platform Integrations
HealthGrid

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthgrid.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 18:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical evaluation blueprint + MAP milestones (draft)

Looping in a few operational notes and owners from Redwood side. Per Diego’s draft:

- Rishi: please own the benchmark runs (Week 2). Deliverables: runbook (how p95 is measured), artifact with raw traces, and a short dashboard with cost-per-1k calculation. Target for runbook: Aug 27 COB.
- Hannah: please prepare the deployment checklist for dedicated test capacity (networking, KMS integration, and token limits).
- Diego: coordinate the dataset handoff and confirm we’ll provide a sanitized upload location.
- Marissa (me): I’ll consolidate results and prepare the MAP sign-off matrix (performance vs cost vs quality).

Couple of suggestions: add a canary gating step (0–5% traffic) if HealthGrid wants full integration after initial bench, and include a rollback criterion in the MAP.

I’ll update the redwood-map-draft.xlsx with owners + dates and reattach once done.

-Marissa
Product Lead, Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthgrid.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@healthgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical evaluation blueprint + MAP milestones (draft)

Thanks — I’ll take the benchmark ownership. Quick notes on measurement and a couple of tweaks: 

- Measurement: p95 will be measured server-side from request arrival to final token emit (end-to-end within Redwood runtime). Network RTT not included; we’ll publish a reproducible harness so HealthGrid can reproduce locally.
- Assumptions for cost calc: batch size = 8, avg output length = 600 tokens, no caching on first pass. I’ll produce a table with sensitivity to batch size.
- Suggested latency target: given the 2k input case, we should evaluate both (a) p95 for 512-token typical outputs and (b) p95 for 2k-token worst-case. Proposed p95 targets: 150 ms (512 tokens), 750 ms (2k tokens) — feel free to push back if HealthGrid needs stricter numbers.
- Model shortlist: I recommend adding a smaller low-latency baseline (Mistral-7B-quant) and a higher-quality 13B candidate.

Deliverables & dates: runbook & bench script (Aug 27), raw traces + cost table (Sep 4), dashboard (Sep 8). I’ll attach the initial latency-bench-script.sh to the MAP.

-rm
Rishi Malhotra
Performance Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthgrid.com>

Diego / team —

This looks good and actionable. A few quick confirmations: 
- Wed Aug 26 10:00 PT works for the workshop — please send the calendar invite and an agenda (90 minutes).
- We accept the proposed milestones and owners; procurement will run budget checks in parallel but expects clarification on the cost assumptions (Rishi’s table helps).
- For SOC2/DR notes: I asked procure@healthgrid.com to list the required artifacts; Diego, can you provide a short one-pager on data flow and retention for the test run by Aug 24?

If all that’s in place, we’ll target the mutual sign-off on 2026-09-30 and begin procurement for reserved test capacity the week of Sep 7.

Thanks — Elena
